answer: Radio-Shadow Identity Cells.** Each identity is bound to a physical location cell whose ambient radio signature (the local gale of noise, a violet band of interference) is continuously measured by co-located sensors. To register, an operator must place hardware inside that cell and pass a live challenge: sensors verify the device hears the same ambient echo as neighbors. A single operator cannot fake this remotely, because each cell's signature is physically local and changes unpredictably.
